values.RUNTIME_SECRETS_LOCATION: the Netlify UI (site settings → environment variables, both sites)
values.BUILD_VERIFY_METHOD: Fetch `https://trailhead.example.com/build-meta.json?<timestamp>` and compare its `commitRef` with the pushed SHA. A mismatch after five minutes means the build failed.
values.DEPLOY_NOTE: Pushing `main` is the production deploy: Netlify auto-publishes it.
values.DB_LOCAL_CHECK: supabase db reset && supabase test db
values.CONTEXT_BUDGET_CHECK: After the fold, run `node .claude/scripts/context-size.mjs`. A file over budget gets split (`docs/harness-notes.md` › How to split) before the push.
